sources.title: Granite Vision: a lightweight, open-source multimodal model for ...
sources.snippet: The architecture of Granite Vision is centered around visual modality alignment with a decoder-only, 2 billion-parameter Granite large language model. Additionally, we introduce a dedicated safety classification approach in test-time that leverages a sparse set of attention vectors to identify potential harmful inputs.
